note: Both sets struggle significantly with the two-column layout of the circuit breaker schedule, frequently combining the left and right circuit numbers for a single load (e.g., assigning '1, 2' to the Cooktop instead of '2, 4'). Set A is slightly better because it avoids inventing incorrect breaker ratings for specific circuits, whereas Set B hallucinates several incorrect ratings (such as Circuit 34 being 30A and Circuit 38 being 50A). Both sets contain many vague or misbound claims.
